summary: The compact gabled silhouette is charming and coherent, but the entrance is on the wrong face and the dominant materials do not match the reference hut.

orientation.summary: Located SV1 looks NE toward the studio’s -v/SW face and shows a door in that broad eave-side wall. The labeled four-face sheet shows -v blank, while the actual inventory places the sole door on the -u/SE gable face. Thus the rendered principal entry conflicts with the geolocated evidence; road proximity is not being used as proof.

issues.problem: The sole principal door is on -u, but SV1 supports it on -v.
issues.fix: Move the principal door to the -v/SW eave wall and leave -u without a principal portal; retain only one principal entrance.

issues.problem: Brick walls and a shingle-pattern roof miss the reference’s characteristic reddish-brown shingle siding and pale corrugated-metal roof.
issues.fix: Replace the brick relief with broad staggered shingle courses and use a light metal roof with clear parallel ribs.
